description: This script provides functions for platform-specific image upgrade procedures, including checking image compatibility, copying configuration data, and performing the actual upgrade by writing images to disk and partitions. It includes operations such as partition extraction, image comparison, and device writing commands.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image to ensure the partition layout matches the expected layout, extracting partition tables and comparing them, aborting if differences are found.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Backs up configuration data by mounting the target partition and copying backup files to it.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to perform the upgrade process, writing the boot sector and partitions from the image to the target device, updating UUIDs, and handling partition comparisons.
